text.description_html:
Rockwood 614V, Modern Rectangular Door Knocker With Viewer

This modern cast brass viewer door knocker includes a 190 degree UL Listed viewer that elevates both the safety and aesthetics of your doors. This door viewer offers an impressively wide 190-degree field of view, enabling you to see the area outside your door clearly without the need to open it, thereby enhancing security and convenience. This Rockwood Door Knocker offers versatility with its viewer - adding a practical feature for enhanced security and convenience, while simultaneously embodying a sleek and modern style.

Specifications for the Rockwood Rectangular Modern Door Knocker:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Height: 3"
  • Width: 2-1/8"
  • Mounting Centers: 2-1/2" c.c. (distance between the 2 mounting screw holes)
  • Max Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Mounting: #8-32 Thru-Bolt Screws
  • Includes matching finish 190 degree UL Listed eye viewer.
  • Includes matching finish mounting hardware.
  • Rockwood 614V Dimensions (PDF)

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
